scale: GO 2026-07-26, ChEBI lite 256, the 298 ORE 2015 EL ontologies and the 400 fixtures of tests/fixtures/el587

manifest.build: MBX_LEARNED_INCREMENTAL=false mbx build --release -p sparkles-owl --example el_classify on stanley

references.before: the taxonomies of the build of commit 91a7b160 in runs/2026-11-02-reasoners-agreement-91a7b160, equal to ELK 0.6.0's
references.konclude: Konclude 0.7.0-1138 taxonomies of the same record
references.fixtures: HermiT 1.4.5.519 and Konclude 0.7.0-1138 on the 400 fixtures, run by run-references.sh from the nix/reasoners packages

method: agree.sh classifies each ontology on four threads, writes the taxonomy and compares it with scripts/el-oracle.py against the build before the lane and against Konclude. tests/el_fixtures.rs compares the classifier's subsumptions between named classes on each fixture with HermiT's and Konclude's, read from the reasoners' direct hierarchies.

notes: ore_ont_6720 is inconsistent. The lane's taxonomy makes every class equivalent to owl:Nothing, as Konclude's does, and is byte for byte the taxonomy of the base build c9b6ebff (sha256 e3e2f8ff...). The build of commit 91a7b160 kept owl:Thing apart, which is the difference against_before reports.
GO differs from Konclude by the 7 missing and 2 extra direct edges that InverseObjectProperties(part_of has_part) gives, an axiom outside OWL 2 EL.
